title: Glam Metal
style: aor classic rock, arena rock, 80's, male singer, Background vocals, catchy
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
It's always like the first time with you.
Every Morning when i wake up.
Your warmth on my skin, your smell on the pillow.
The two of us. Nothing made up.

(Pre-Chorus)
You know this feels just right.
Growing stronger with every kiss.
I want this feeling all my life.
That's why I promise you this.

[Hymnic Chorus]
I’ll stand by your side, Forever! (Forever!)
No matter what, no matter when.

Our love will never fade, Forever! (Forever!)
Only You and I, in every choice we made. (Uuhuhuuu)

You made me realize that love can stay.
(Forever!) Forever, We'll be!

[Verse]
I can't imagine a day without you.
On your side I have to be.
The Glance in your eyes and the words you say.
For your love I thank you dear.

(Pre-Chorus)
You know this is who we are.
Our love can not be tamed.
I want this feeling all my life.
And that's why I swear it again.

[Hymnic Second Chorus]
I’ll stand by your side, Forever! (Forever!)
No matter what, no matter when.

Our love will never fade, Forever! (Forever!)
Only You and I, in every choice we made. (Uuhuhuuu)

You made me realize that love can stay.
(Forever!) Forever, We'll be!
[Keyboard Solo]

[Drum Solo]

[Bridge]
I'll do everything to keep your love.
I'll turn whole wide world into the light.
I'll pick up every Star from the sky above.
Just to make you feel alright...
And I promise you everyday.

[Final Chorus]
I’ll stand by your side, Forever! (Forever!)
No matter what, no matter when.

Our love will never fade, Forever! (Forever!)
Only You and I, in every choice we made. (Uuhuhuuu)

You made me realize that love can stay.
(Forever!) Forever, We'll be!
[Epic Emotional Beautiful Guitar Solo]

[Elements from the whole Song fit the end]

[Fade out]
